scope.summary: This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for thiamethoxam, technical, which is used as an active ingredient in formulating high-efficiency systemic insecticides to control agricultural sucking and chewing pests.

certification_and_marking.certification_status: Voluntary/Mandatory under the Insecticides Act. Manufacturers are encouraged to apply for the prestigious BIS 'Standard Mark' (ISI Mark) to print on product containers as a certified assurance of quality. Additionally, all packaging, labeling, and distribution of technical-grade thiamethoxam must strictly comply with statutory registrations and warning declarations mandated under the Insecticides Act, 1968 and Rules framed thereunder.

requirements.detail: Mandates that the active thiamethoxam content shall be a minimum of 98.0 percent by weight (percent w/w minimum, determined quantitatively by HPLC using acetonitrile mobile phase and internal standard calibration).
Restricts moisture content to a maximum of 0.5 percent by mass, determined in accordance with the method prescribed in Clause 4 of IS 6940.
Restricts free acidity (calculated as H2SO4) to a maximum of 0.5 percent by mass, determined in accordance with the method prescribed in Clause 11.3.2 of IS 6940.
Limits material insoluble in acetone to a maximum of 0.5 percent by mass, determined in accordance with the method prescribed in Clause 9 of IS 6940.

Technical thiamethoxam must be securely packed in containers satisfying the general requirements of IS 8190 (Part 1) for solid technical pesticides. Sampling of the technical material shall be carried out as prescribed in IS 10946.

Each container must legibly and indelibly bear: the name of the material, manufacturer's name and address, batch number, date of manufacture, date of expiry, net quantity, nominal thiamethoxam content (percent m/m), and standard cautionary notices worded in accordance with the Insecticides Act, 1968.

Requires weighing about 0.2 g of thiamethoxam, technical into a 50 ml volumetric flask. Dissolves and makes up the volume to the mark with acetonitrile. Pipettes out 5 ml of this solution into a 100 ml volumetric flask, adds 5 ml of internal standard solution, and makes up to the mark with acetonitrile before shaking to homogenize.
Injects a 20 µl aliquot of the prepared solution into a high-performance liquid chromatograph (HPLC) equipped with a UV detector to resolve active thiamethoxam and the internal standard.

The chromatographic system must cleanly resolve the active ingredient and internal standard. Based on the calibrated sample chromatogram, the typical retention times are approximately 2.79 minutes and 7.50 minutes.

Any observed or calculated test or analysis value expressing purity, moisture, acidity, or insolubles must be mathematically rounded off in accordance with IS 2 : 1960. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be identical to the specified value in the standard.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 15983 : 2013 is the national Indian Standard specification establishing technical requirements, sampling protocols, and analytical methods for thiamethoxam, technical. Prepared by the FAD 1 Sectional Committee, this standard regulates the chemical quality of this active neonicotinoid ingredient, which is widely utilized in crop protection formulations to control sucking pests. It mandates a minimum purity of 98.0% by mass, limits moisture to 0.5%, acidity to 0.5%, and acetone insolubles to 0.5%. It outlines a precise High Performance Liquid Chromatography (HPLC) test using an internal standard technique in an acetonitrile solvent, ensuring both efficacy and environmental compliance under the statutory framework of the Insecticides Act, 1968.
